data.description: If an attack strikes the wearer and deals at least 10 points of electricity damage, as a swift action on the wearer's next turn that does not provoke an attack of opportunity, she may use shocking grasp as a spell-like ability, dealing 1d6 points of electricity damage for every 10 points of damage dealt to the wearer since last turn.
